nodes.label: Antenna fix (FIX=1)

nodes.norm_label: cnn_top p16 layout with 14 sram macros (unfinished)
nodes.rationale: Routing clean, TT/FF timing clean, SS corner fails (only TT lib for OpenRAM); XOR/DRC/LVS failed OOM on 8 GB laptop.

nodes.label: setup/python-requirements.txt
nodes.rationale: Pinned versions used when repo results were produced (Python 3.12); training packages (torch, librosa) intentionally excluded.

nodes.label: Machine requirements (cnn_top macro layout >= 16 GB RAM)
nodes.norm_label: machine requirements (cnn_top macro layout >= 16 gb ram)
nodes.rationale: Magic/KLayout ran out of memory (>7 GB) on 8 GB laptop for cnn_top with 14 SRAM macros.

nodes.label: Memory as OpenRAM SRAM macros, not flip-flops
nodes.norm_label: memory as openram sram macros, not flip-flops
nodes.rationale: 116 Kbit weight ROM synthesized as logic stalled global routing (>40 min vs 27 s with stub), so ROM became 8 SRAM macros loaded via wl_* port; differs from FPGA RTL filled ROM.

nodes.label: Pmod J2 pin mapping (UART, I2S INMP441, LEDs)
nodes.norm_label: pmod j2 pin mapping (uart, i2s inmp441, leds)
nodes.rationale: Board UART connects to PS not PL, so PL UART uses Pmod; pins from AMD kv260_bist pin.xdc, physical Pmod numbers assumed.

nodes.label: KV260 unverified items (bitstream not loaded on board)
nodes.norm_label: kv260 unverified items (bitstream not loaded on board)

nodes.label: sky130 clock 40 MHz (25 ns)
nodes.rationale: Single clock for all sky130 layouts; not directly comparable to FPGA clock (KV260 300 MHz) due to different process and cells.

nodes.label: Core clock 300.032 MHz = 293 x 1.024 MHz (K-24)
nodes.rationale: 333.82 MHz full build failed for P=16; 300.032 MHz gives integer BCLK divisor 293 for exact 16 kHz; actual MMCM output 299.997 MHz.

nodes.label: Recommendation P = 32
nodes.rationale: Loosest WNS (+0.219 ns) at chosen clock and fewest CNN cycles (122,872 = 0.41 ms derived).

nodes.label: Artix-7 XC7A35T-1 synthesis reference
nodes.rationale: Report reference only, not a promise of demo hardware.

nodes.label: sv2v + synth_xilinx -family xc7 (no timing)
nodes.rationale: Yosys 0.33 cannot read package import and function return, so sv2v is used; numbers are cross-tool comparison only, not Vivado prediction.

nodes.label: Device-specific code only in target/
nodes.rationale: RTL stays vendor-neutral because the event FPGA is provided by organizers and not yet announced; pins/MMCM/constraints live only in target/.
